summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 3 new features (server-side branded PDF report, OCR-aware upload path, semantic-embeddings requirement matching) plus regressions. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 6 new tests (report download 200/%PDF/>3KB/attachment header, report auth-required, report workspace-isolation 404, report on nonexistent 404, OCR-change upload regression, and full-pipeline semantic retrieval verifying 'Similar completed projects'=FAIL and 'turnover'=PASS via 42 Cr → 30 Cr semantic match). Full suite = 25 tests, all passing (2 full ~60s AI pipeline runs; total ~2m28s). Brute-force lockout previously reported broken is now fixed and returns 429 after 5 attempts. Frontend: seeded demo → /analyses/demo-analysis-0001/decision, clicked data-testid='export-report-btn'; Playwright captured a real download event (Blob-based) yielding 'BidPilot - Bengaluru Metro Corridor-7 — Civil Works Package C4.pdf' 5704 bytes, %PDF header, 'Report downloaded' success toast, and zero console errors. Demo dashboard remains total=1, conditional=1, decision BID WITH CONDITIONS at 76%.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /analyses/{aid}/report correctly enforces workspace scope and status=='completed' (returns 400 for pending, 404 for missing/other-workspace).

Frontend exportReport uses api.raw with responseType blob and creates an object URL – good pattern; download works end-to-end. Filename may contain em-dash characters; Content-Disposition is quoted so it works, but consider stripping non-ASCII for cross-browser safety.

OCR-change upload flow: minimal (very short) text PDFs are classified as is_scanned and marked 'Needs Review' (verification_state) even though parse succeeded – acceptable heuristic, but consider a minimum-text-length threshold that's less strict than current (an 11-char extract triggers scanned=true).
AnalysisWorkspace.jsx exportReport catch swallows the error object; consider logging response status to help future debugging.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created & cleaned up: TEST_ocr_regress.pdf (deleted; also cleaned a stale artefact from an earlier failing run), TEST_Real_Run and TEST_Semantic_Run analyses (deleted). Demo workspace analyses total remains 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 25 tests including two ~60s full-pipeline runs (real Claude). Run with: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml (takes ~2.5 min). New feature tests are grouped under 'New Features (iteration 2)' at bottom.
